types.title: Pulse Resource
types.description: An observed resource with metrics, events, or states.

types.title: Pulse Saved Query
types.description: A named, validated Pulse query stored in a Base.

types.title: Pulse Source
types.description: A telemetry source and its current ingest or scrape health.

queries.title: List Pulse Bases
queries.description: Normal entry for Base-scoped telemetry work. List accessible Pulse Bases and use returned pulse.base refs or IDs with readers, source and signal discovery, or query calls.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read Pulse Base
queries.description: Read one pulse.base ref returned by base.list or base.search.

id.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Search Pulse Bases
queries.description: Find an accessible Pulse Base by name or description when its ID is unknown. Use returned pulse.base refs with base.read or their IDs with source.list, metric.search, field.search, and query tools.

query.description: User-entered search text. Empty text is allowed when a facet narrows the query.

tags.description: Canonical search facets supported by this query.

scope.description: Optional resource containing the search results; must be an explicitly supported scope type.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Search Pulse Fields
queries.description: Discover dimension or attribute keys for metrics, events, and states in one known Base without exposing values. Use metric.search for metric names, then query.compile before query.execute.

baseId.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

role.description: Field role to discover; sensitive fields are excluded.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Search Pulse Metrics
queries.description: Discover metric names and types before authoring a query in one known Base. Get baseId from base.list or base.search; validate the resulting DSL with query.compile before query.execute.

baseId.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Compile Pulse Query
queries.description: Validate Pulse query DSL for a baseId from base.list or base.search without reading telemetry rows. Use metric.search and field.search to discover valid names; execute valid DSL with query.execute.

baseId.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

queries.title: Execute telemetry query
queries.description: Execute Pulse query DSL for a baseId from base.list or base.search, normally after query.compile. Returns at most 500 points or 100 compact rows; raw event payloads are omitted and truncated reports omitted results.

baseId.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

queries.title: Read Pulse Resource
queries.description: Read one observed Pulse Resource by passing the composite ID from a resource.search pulse.resource ref unchanged.

id.description: Composite Base-ID/resource-key value returned by Search Pulse Resources in a pulse.resource ref; pass the ref id unchanged.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Search Pulse Resources
queries.description: Direct cross-Base entry for finding observed resources. Use the returned composite pulse.resource ref unchanged with resource.read; use metric.search or field.search when authoring a query in one known Base.

query.description: User-entered search text. Empty text is allowed when a facet narrows the query.

tags.description: Canonical search facets supported by this query.

scope.description: Optional resource containing the search results; must be an explicitly supported scope type.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Execute saved telemetry query
queries.description: Execute one stored query using baseId and queryId from saved_query.list. This skips query.compile because the stored DSL is already validated and returns the same bounded result as query.execute.

baseId.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

queryId.description: Saved-query ID returned by List saved Pulse Queries or a pulse.saved_query ref.

queries.title: List saved Pulse Queries
queries.description: List named queries in one known Base. Get baseId from base.list or base.search; use returned pulse.saved_query refs with saved_query.read or their IDs with saved_query.execute.

baseId.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

queries.title: Read saved Pulse Query
queries.description: Read one pulse.saved_query ref returned by saved_query.list, including its stored DSL and Base ID.

id.description: Saved-query ID returned by List saved Pulse Queries or a pulse.saved_query ref.

queries.title: List Pulse Sources
queries.description: List source health in one known Base without exposing credentials. Get baseId from base.list or base.search; use returned pulse.source refs with source.read.

baseId.description: Pulse Base ID returned by Search/List Pulse Bases or a pulse.base ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read Pulse Source
queries.description: Read one pulse.source ref returned by source.list, including its current ingest or scrape health.

id.description: Pulse Source ID returned by List Pulse Sources or a pulse.source ref.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.
